label: AGENTS.md#Default to background-subagent dispatch chunk 12
title: AGENTS.md#Default to background-subagent dispatch chunk 12
summary: Worker registration rides the assignment claim, not the start hook. The SubagentStart hook does NOT fire for run_in_background Agent-tool spawns, so a background worker never carries agent_tool_spawn:true. No extra registration field is needed in the envelope: subconscious_assignment accept routes to the same /overlay/status in_progress path as raw start_task and self-registers the worker on claim. The /overlay/status in_progress handler treats a claim that bears an agent_id AND is backed by a registered worktree (proof branch_task ran — the dispatcher never calls it) as a legitimate hook-less worker, registers it, and allows the claim. The registered worktree is the security boundary: a claim with no worktree is still refused. So the branch_task → start_task order IS the registration — nothing else to carry. When start_task accepts a registered worker claim, the daemon also mints or renews the scoped Subconscious execution permit for that claim; normal workers must not add a separate manual permit step before writing.
